description: Verviers - bulles à verre, bulles à vêtements et conteneurs enterrés is a group of related datasets listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Verviers. Le jeu de données comprend les géolocalisations des bulles à verre sur le territoire de la Ville de Verviers. The 3 datasets in this record: Bulles à verre - Verviers; Bulles à vêtements - Verviers; Conteneurs enterrés - Verviers. Coverage: Verviers. The portal lists 3 related datasets of one publisher (copies, years or sister lists), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under Agriculture, Environnement. Its keywords are bulle, verre. The portal shows 62 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-09-04 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste collection, treatment and recycling network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
